official: Predicting High-Risk Carotid Plaque: Integrating radioMics and biomEchanics
summary: Non-pharmacological interventional study for the development of a predictive model aimed at identifying unstable carotid plaques in asymptomatic patients at first diagnosis, with the use of biological material and prospective-retrospective data collection
